messages:
Maria Chen: Quick protocol draft: 'claim escrow' flow for SI co-sells. Goal: deterministic ownership, 0 surprise demos, clear evidence for credit.
James Park: Love the name. What are the states?
Tia Gomez: States idea: pending_claim -> escrowed (evidence required) -> active -> released -> contested. Escrowed means SI has 72h to provide discovery notes + recording.
Devon Lee: On contested: require manager approval within 24h or default to prior owner. Also add a TTL: if escrowed and no evidence after 72h -> auto-release back to Redwood AE.
Samir Patel: Automation commands for partners: `/claim --partner="helium-sys" --acct=ACCT-4422 --intent=demo` and `/claim-evidence --acct=ACCT-4422 --note="recording_url"`. marketplace-bot: claim-service: received claim ACCT-4422 status=pending.
marketplace-bot: claim-service: ACCT-4422 transitioned -> escrowed (deadline=+72h).
Maria Chen: Add a required metadata field `evidence_type` (meeting-note|recording|logged-demo). If evidence missing, partner loses initial credit.
James Park: How do we show this in the marketplace UI? Suggest badge states: "claimed (escrowed)", "claimed (active)", "demo_hold", "contested". Also show partner contact and claim_ts.
Tia Gomez: For sales ops: we need a daily CSV with columns: acct, partner, claim_ts, state, evidence_type, evidence_url, prior_owner, contested_by, last_event_ts. Please include human-readable history URL.
Devon Lee: I'll wire the webhook and attach `audit_url` to each claim. Also implementing an admin endpoint for manager approvals: POST /claims/{id}/resolve (approve|deny).
Samir Patel: Edge case: split-credit where both SI+Redwood contributed. Proposal: allow setting `split=si:40,redwood:60` at time of conversion with manager approval and supporting notes. Record in audit.
Maria Chen: Good. Add SLA for handoffs: 24h acknowledgement for new claims from AEs; 72h evidence window; 48h reclaim window if prior owner objects. All escalations to partnerships@redwood if timers expire.
marketplace-bot: claim-service: event=auto_release acct=ACCT-3311 reason=escrow_expired
Tia Gomez: Ops question: who owns post-conversion renewals if split-credit used? Need a primary account owner for renewals; split only affects revenue credit. Primary owner should be a required field on conversion.
James Park: We'll enforce `primary_owner` on opportunity creation in CRM. Billing team wants a record link to the claim for payouts.
Devon Lee: I'll include claim_id on CRM opp metadata and link to audit_url.
Samir Patel: Quick UX ask: add an in-list filter in marketplace: "claimed-by me", "claimed-but-escrowed", "contested". That'll cut noise.
Maria Chen: Action items: Devon - webhook + admin approve endpoint + audit_url (EOD Tue); Samir - implement UI badges + filters + evidence flow (end of week); James - add `primary_owner` enforcement in CRM mapping; Tia - define CSV & reconciliation process and run first pass next Wed.
Tia Gomez: I'll also draft a 1-pager for partners describing the escrow flow and evidence requirements.
Maria Chen: Great. If we ship this before the joint announcement, we should see far fewer disputes. I'll post the Confluence draft when done. :white_check_mark:
